items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I recall they had all the kids like, Kid Punch, Kid Rene, Kid Tibor Remy, Kid Clayton, Chris Kelly, Kid Shots, and many, many others.

ctx.x: Yeah, I like the automobile like that now. No, you didn't like that. Everything was quiet, you see. It was wonderful, I'm telling you. It was wonderful. Now, we had some wonderful bands. I could name you some of those bands, let's see. They had the Golden Leaf Band. They had the Maple Leaf Band. They had the Supreme Band. They had the Crescent City Band. They had the Superior Band. They had the Olympic Band. They had the Eagle Band. They had the Eagle Band. All those bands. And later on they had, I recall they…
Why did they call them Kid?
